answer: Commit-reveal admission ties registration to a future beacon. Step 1: each candidate locks a hash of (identity, salt) plus a 2-unit ember deposit one epoch ahead. Step 2: the closing block publishes the raven draw; only salts opening against it join the cohort. Step 3: admitted identities pass three liveness probes across ten epochs; the deposit exits via a canyon gate held 15 more epochs. Cost check: 100 sybils commit 200 units and face 300 probes; at 10% per-probe failure about 59 survive, recovering 118 and losing 82; honest agents risk nothing.
